icloud_contacts.title: Match names from iCloud Contacts
icloud_contacts.description:
Use an app-specific password from the same Apple Account. Apple Find reads the address book and matches names by email address or phone number. Leave this blank to turn off matching.

[How to create an app-specific password]({password_guide_url})

apple_login.title: 登录 Apple 账户
apple_login.description: 使用 Apple 账户密码登录 HA 上的原生查找采集器。

apple_verification.title: Apple 双重认证
apple_verification.description: 在受信任设备上点「允许」，然后输入这次显示的六位验证码。需要新验证码时，可勾选重新发送。
